name: fleet-repomix-map-staleness
title: Fleet refresh lanes leave the consumer repomix map stale between releases
description: Fleet refresh lanes can leave a consumer's docs/repomix-map.md stale across releases; the next lane that regenerates it produces a mass-removal diff that fails the consumer's own Prism gate on a correct mechanical change. Observed on rwbp-coordinator during the 0.71.33 rollout: 14 insertions, 217 deletions, every removed row an .agents/skills/sd-* entry absent from disk since that consumer's thin conversion.
creator: sdelmas
